Task: Define required datasets and fields
Task Explanation: List exactly what data the project needs before searching for sources. Include required variables, units, time resolution, duration, geographic scope, and minimum quality for load, renewable generation/weather, network parameters, and BESS/economic data.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Data requirement list: load, PV/weather, network, economic/BESS parameters

Task: Acquire load-demand time-series data
Task Explanation: Find a historical electricity-demand dataset suitable for time-series simulation and uncertainty analysis. Record where it came from, what area/system it represents, sampling interval, period covered, units, and any missing values.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Usable historical load dataset with source/provenance

Task: Acquire solar / weather / PV data
Task Explanation: Find renewable-resource data that can represent PV uncertainty, preferably measured irradiance/weather or actual PV generation. Record location, sampling interval, units, period covered, and whether the data can be aligned with the load dataset.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Irradiance/weather or PV generation dataset with source/provenance

Task: Acquire distribution-network reference data
Task Explanation: Obtain electrical parameters for a simple distribution network that can be used first for debugging and demonstration, plus the IEEE 33-bus case for later benchmarking. Required data include buses, lines, impedances, loads, source/slack information, and base values.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Small 5-bus test case + IEEE 33-bus benchmark data

Task: Check data licenses, units, resolution, and provenance
Task Explanation: Review every selected dataset before using it. Confirm source credibility, usage permission, units, timestamps, sampling resolution, missing/outlier values, and whether the data are technically compatible with the project.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Documented source, units, timestamps, missing-data issues and permitted use

Task: Clean, resample, and synchronize datasets
Task Explanation: Convert the selected datasets into a common usable format. Handle missing data, consistent units, timestamp alignment, resampling, normalization/scaling where justified, and document every preprocessing step.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Analysis-ready aligned dataset

Task: Prepare data package for next advisor meeting (TBA)
Task Explanation: Prepare evidence for the next advisor meeting rather than only saying data were found. Bring source links/references, representative plots, dataset coverage/resolution, quality problems, and questions that still need advisor input.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Data sources + sample plots + quality summary + unresolved questions

Task: Define project ethics and professional-responsibility considerations
Task Explanation: Identify ethical and professional-responsibility issues that should influence the design and final report. Cover truthful data/model use, transparent assumptions and limitations, reliability/safety consequences of recommendations, environmental/economic trade-offs, and avoiding presentation of optimizer output as guaranteed real-world decisions.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Ethics note/checklist covering data integrity and provenance, transparent assumptions, grid reliability/safety impacts, model limitations, environmental/economic trade-offs, responsible use, and final-report points

Task: Confirm Term 2 product scope and minimum capabilities
Task Explanation: Agree on what the Term 2 product actually is and what the minimum working version must do. Define the user problem, supported network size, required BESS optimization functions, uncertainty capability, and what is intentionally out of scope.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Approved scope: user-defined distribution system + BESS planning workflow

Task: Define software requirements and user workflow
Task Explanation: Write the program requirements from the user's point of view. Define the main workflow, required inputs, expected outputs, supported file/data formats, error cases, performance expectations, and the minimum features needed for a complete demonstration.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Functional/non-functional requirements and main use cases

Task: Design software architecture and module boundaries
Task Explanation: Design the program as connected modules before heavy coding. Decide how the user interface, data manager, network/power-flow model, BESS model, uncertainty engine, optimizer, validation layer, and results/visualization module are separated and connected.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Architecture diagram covering UI, data, network, uncertainty, optimization, results

Task: Define module interfaces and data flow
Task Explanation: Specify what each module receives and returns. Define data structures, units, array/table formats, function/API boundaries, and the exact sequence of information moving from imported data through simulation and optimization to final results.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Inputs/outputs and data structures between modules

Task: Finalize network and power-flow assumptions
Task Explanation: Freeze the electrical-network modeling assumptions needed for implementation. Decide the radial-network representation, source/slack bus, line model, load model, base quantities, voltage limits, power-flow solver, and handling of infeasible or disconnected networks.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Network model, slack/source, line model, voltage limits, solver choice

Task: Finalize BESS mathematical model
Task Explanation: Write the battery model that the code will implement. Define energy and power ratings, SOC update equations, charge/discharge efficiency, operating limits, initial/final SOC, simultaneous charge/discharge handling, and any degradation or technology assumptions.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: SOC equation, efficiency, charge/discharge limits, energy/power ratings

Task: Finalize objective function, constraints, and metrics
Task Explanation: Define the optimization problem mathematically. State the decision variables, objective components, normalization/weighting method, technical/economic constraints, penalties for infeasible solutions, and every metric that will be reported.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Mathematical optimization problem and normalized performance metrics

Task: Define uncertainty and scenario methodology
Task Explanation: Define how renewable/load uncertainty will be represented from real data. Specify forecasting or forecast-error modeling, Monte Carlo sampling, scenario probabilities, number of scenarios, reduction/selection method, and how scenarios enter the BESS optimization.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Forecast-error model, Monte Carlo method, scenario handling/reduction method

Task: Design validation and software test plan
Task Explanation: Design the tests before implementation is complete. Define simple reference cases and acceptance checks for power flow, battery SOC, optimizer correctness, uncertainty generation, robustness, software inputs/errors, and final end-to-end behavior.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Power-flow, BESS, optimizer, uncertainty, robustness and software test cases

Task: Build deterministic 5-bus network engine
Task Explanation: Build the smallest complete network simulator first. The program should create or load a configurable radial system of about five buses, run it deterministically, and provide a stable foundation for adding BESS and uncertainty later.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Runnable small network with configurable buses/lines/loads/source

Task: Implement baseline power flow and basic visualization
Task Explanation: Run the 5-bus network without BESS and show useful engineering outputs such as bus voltage, line loading/current, losses, and power balance. Use this as the baseline that later optimized cases will be compared against.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Bus voltage, line loading/losses and baseline result plots/tables

Task: Implement data import and time-series handling
Task Explanation: Implement reliable loading of the cleaned load/PV time-series data into the simulator. Check timestamps, lengths, units, scaling, missing values, and make the profiles usable by the hourly or sub-hourly simulation loop.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Load/PV profile import, alignment, scaling and validation

Task: Implement BESS SOC and dispatch simulation
Task Explanation: Add BESS operation to the network simulation. Update SOC across time, enforce energy/power/efficiency limits, determine charge/discharge power, and make sure the battery changes the network power flow correctly at its connected bus.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Working battery model integrated with time-series power flow

Task: Implement deterministic BESS sizing and placement optimization
Task Explanation: Implement a first optimizer using deterministic profiles only. It should search/select BESS bus location, power rating, and energy capacity while evaluating the objective and constraints through the simulation model.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Optimizer selects bus, power rating and energy capacity

Task: Verify optimizer against exhaustive search on small case
Task Explanation: For a deliberately small search space, calculate the optimum by enumerating all permitted BESS options and compare it with the selected optimizer. This gives a reference for checking whether the optimization algorithm is actually finding the correct solution.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Known/reference optimum for a constrained 5-bus test case

Task: Implement forecasting / forecast-error model
Task Explanation: Build and validate the forecasting or forecast-error model using the selected data. Measure prediction/error performance with appropriate metrics and retain the error behavior needed to generate realistic uncertain scenarios.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Validated forecast/error model with suitable error metrics

Task: Implement Monte Carlo scenario generation
Task Explanation: Generate many plausible renewable/load trajectories from the fitted uncertainty/error model. Check that generated scenarios have realistic ranges, variability, temporal behavior, and statistical similarity to the underlying data.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Renewable/load uncertainty scenarios generated from data/error model

Task: Implement representative-scenario selection/reduction
Task Explanation: If the full scenario set is too expensive, reduce it using a defensible representative-scenario method rather than an arbitrary best/worst/random split. Check that the reduced set preserves important distributions and extreme behavior.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Defensible reduced scenario set with preservation checks

Task: Integrate uncertainty-aware BESS optimization
Task Explanation: Extend BESS sizing and placement so one planning decision is evaluated across many uncertainty scenarios. Define how scenario costs/performance are aggregated and make the selected battery robust to plausible renewable/load deviations.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Sizing/placement evaluated across renewable/load scenarios

Task: Build minimum decision-support user interface
Task Explanation: Build a simple user-facing application around the engineering model. The minimum UI should let the user configure/load a network and profiles, run a baseline simulation, start optimization, and inspect the main results without editing source code.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: UI for network/data setup, baseline run, optimization and results

Task: Integrate optimizer, scenarios, and results into UI
Task Explanation: Connect the completed backend modules to the UI so the full workflow works from user input to recommendation. Handle progress/errors clearly and display the selected BESS location, MW/MWh ratings, and relevant technical/economic results.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: End-to-end program workflow from user inputs to BESS recommendation

Task: Compare baseline vs optimized BESS system
Task Explanation: Quantify what the BESS changes. Compare the same network and data with no BESS and with the optimized BESS using voltage, losses, curtailment, load shedding, cost, reliability, or other finalized metrics.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Technical/economic before-vs-after results

Task: Compare deterministic vs uncertainty-aware designs
Task Explanation: Design one BESS using deterministic inputs and another using uncertainty-aware optimization, then test both on a common set of unseen scenarios. Compare how often constraints are violated and how technical/economic performance changes.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Evidence of whether uncertainty-aware planning improves robustness

Task: Run sensitivity and robustness testing
Task Explanation: Change important assumptions one at a time to see whether conclusions are stable. Examples include scenario count, optimizer population/iterations, objective weights, battery cost, renewable penetration, forecast error, and battery efficiency.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Sensitivity to scenario count, optimizer settings, weights/costs and uncertainty

Task: Scale and validate on IEEE 33-bus case
Task Explanation: Run the final framework on the IEEE 33-bus distribution system after the small system is stable. Check that the software can scale, produces reasonable benchmark behavior, and does not depend on hard-coded 5-bus assumptions.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Benchmark case demonstrating scalability beyond the 5-bus model

Task: Test error handling, invalid inputs, and failure cases
Task Explanation: Test the application as software, not only as a mathematical model. Try missing/invalid files, disconnected networks, bad units, impossible BESS limits, optimization non-convergence, empty data, and other likely user mistakes or failure conditions.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Software test record and fixes for common invalid/failed cases

Task: Freeze final simulation cases and generate final figures/tables
Task Explanation: Lock the model and important settings before producing report figures. Re-run the chosen cases consistently and save the exact input data, parameters, seeds if relevant, tables, plots, and outputs needed to reproduce the final results.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Reproducible final results package

Task: Update final report and technical documentation
Task Explanation: Update the final report and user/technical documentation from the implemented system. Explain architecture, equations, assumptions, data, ethics, implementation, validation, results, limitations, and how another user can reproduce or operate the tool.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Methods, architecture, ethics/professional responsibility, validation, results, limitations and user documentation

Task: Prepare final presentation and live software demo
Task Explanation: Prepare a presentation that demonstrates the engineering design and the working product. Plan a short live workflow, key before/after and uncertainty results, architecture explanation, validation evidence, and backup screenshots/results in case the demo fails.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Presentation, demo workflow and backup screenshots/results

Task: Final QA, reproducibility check, and submission buffer
Task Explanation: Perform one clean end-to-end run using the documented setup and verify that another team member can reproduce the main result. Fix critical issues, check submission files, references, figures, code/data organization, and keep remaining time as contingency.
Deliverable / Definition of Done: Clean run from data import to final recommendation + submission-ready package
